ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 55-60% high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes and 40-45% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central region and vertical streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black central core extending from the peduncle; wide high-intensity white lobes featuring irregular low-intensity vertical streaks and speckling localized primarily on the left lobe and inner trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 30-35 degrees and significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep transitioning to a slightly convex curve at the distal tips; symmetrical upward orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Symmetric clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel nodes located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical, low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white field of the left lobe and fewer, thinner vertical marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark vertical linear scarring on both lobes; circular scarring/barnacle attachment sites at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, thick vertical black band or 'drip' pattern on the left lobe approximately one-third of the way from the tip toward the notch.
